The '''SP-R0 Power Droid''' was a model of [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The SP-R0 Power Droid first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a pet.
